roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.summary: Build accessible, responsive interfaces that turn product ideas into dependable browser experiences.

grounding.relationship: Closest O*NET occupation reference for Pathfinder's frontend path. Pathfinder's role title and five milestones are original student-facing curation, not an O*NET occupation or assessment result.

milestones.title: Web foundations
milestones.objective: Create semantic pages that adapt cleanly across mobile and desktop screens.
milestones.practical_task: Build a responsive student-event landing page from a written brief.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Deployed responsive landing page with an accessibility checklist.

milestones.title: Interactive JavaScript
milestones.objective: Use JavaScript to manage user input, state, and dynamic interface updates.
milestones.practical_task: Create a searchable task board using browser storage.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Interactive task board repository with meaningful commits.

milestones.title: React application patterns
milestones.objective: Build component-based interfaces with predictable state and reusable UI patterns.
milestones.practical_task: Convert the task board into a React application with reusable components.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: React task board deployed with a clear component structure.

milestones.title: Quality and accessibility
milestones.objective: Validate essential user flows and improve accessibility before sharing a project.
milestones.practical_task: Write tests for one important interaction and audit keyboard navigation.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Tested interface with an accessibility improvement summary.

milestones.title: Portfolio-ready product
milestones.objective: Ship a polished end-to-end interface and explain the product choices behind it.
milestones.practical_task: Build a student opportunity tracker with search, filters, and saved items.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Live portfolio project with README, screenshots, and product case study.

portfolio_project.title: Student Opportunity Tracker
portfolio_project.brief: Design and build a responsive tool for students to discover, filter, save, and track campus opportunities.

roles.title: Backend Developer
roles.summary: Design APIs, data models, and server-side systems that make digital products reliable and secure.

grounding.relationship: Closest O*NET occupation reference for Pathfinder's backend path. Pathfinder's role title and five milestones are original student-facing curation, not an O*NET occupation or assessment result.

milestones.title: Python foundations
milestones.objective: Write readable Python programs that process data and handle common errors.
milestones.practical_task: Build a command-line study-session tracker.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Version-controlled command-line application with setup instructions.

milestones.title: API fundamentals
milestones.objective: Create an HTTP API with validated requests and clear responses.
milestones.practical_task: Expose study sessions through a small FastAPI CRUD API.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Documented API with interactive OpenAPI docs.

milestones.title: Persistent data
milestones.objective: Model application data and safely query a relational database.
milestones.practical_task: Persist users and study sessions in PostgreSQL.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: API backed by a documented relational schema.

milestones.title: Security and testing
milestones.objective: Protect user data and verify the API's important behaviour.
milestones.practical_task: Add token-based authentication and endpoint tests.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Protected API with automated tests for core flows.

milestones.title: Production-ready service
milestones.objective: Deploy a reliable service with documentation that another developer can use.
milestones.practical_task: Deploy the study tracker API and document environment configuration.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Live API, API docs, tests, and architecture overview.

portfolio_project.title: Student Study Planner API
portfolio_project.brief: Build a secure backend that lets students plan study sessions, track goals, and retrieve a useful weekly summary.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.summary: Turn messy data into clear analysis, dashboards, and recommendations that support better decisions.

grounding.relationship: Closest O*NET occupation reference for Pathfinder's entry-level data-analyst path. O*NET lists Data Analyst as an alternate search title; Pathfinder's role title and milestones are original curation.

milestones.title: Spreadsheet analysis
milestones.objective: Clean, summarize, and inspect structured data using repeatable spreadsheet techniques.
milestones.practical_task: Analyze student event attendance and identify participation trends.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Clean workbook with documented assumptions and summary charts.

milestones.title: Query business questions
milestones.objective: Use SQL to answer precise questions from relational data.
milestones.practical_task: Query an event-registration dataset for retention and attendance patterns.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: SQL query notebook with written findings.

milestones.title: Analyze with Python
milestones.objective: Use Python to clean datasets and repeat analyses reproducibly.
milestones.practical_task: Use pandas to clean and analyze a public student-outcomes dataset.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Reproducible notebook with cleaning decisions explained.

milestones.title: Communicate through visuals
milestones.objective: Select charts that accurately answer the intended decision question.
milestones.practical_task: Create a dashboard or report with three decision-focused visuals.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Annotated dashboard and executive summary.

milestones.title: End-to-end case study
milestones.objective: Frame a decision, analyse real data, and present a recommendation with limitations.
milestones.practical_task: Complete an end-to-end analysis of a public mobility or education dataset.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Portfolio case study with source data, notebook, dashboard, and recommendations.

portfolio_project.title: Student Outcomes Insight Dashboard
portfolio_project.brief: Investigate a public education dataset and deliver a dashboard with evidence-based recommendations for student-support teams.

roles.title: Cloud/DevOps Engineer
roles.summary: Automate delivery and operate cloud infrastructure so applications remain secure, observable, and reliable.

grounding.relationship: Infrastructure reference for Pathfinder's Cloud/DevOps path. It complements the DevOps Engineer title listed under O*NET Software Developers; Pathfinder's combined path is original curation.

milestones.title: Linux and networking basics
milestones.objective: Navigate a Linux environment and explain how basic web traffic reaches an application.
milestones.practical_task: Use shell commands to inspect files, processes, and a local web server.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Command reference and troubleshooting notes in a repository.

milestones.title: Versioned delivery
milestones.objective: Use Git workflows that support safe collaboration and repeatable releases.
milestones.practical_task: Set up a repository with branches, pull requests, and release notes.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Repository demonstrating an understandable delivery history.

milestones.title: Containerized application
milestones.objective: Package a simple service so it runs consistently across environments.
milestones.practical_task: Containerize a small API and run it locally with configuration variables.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Dockerfile and documented local run command.

milestones.title: Cloud deployment
milestones.objective: Deploy a containerized service with a minimal, secure cloud configuration.
milestones.practical_task: Deploy the containerized API to a cloud platform's starter tier.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Deployment diagram and operational runbook.

milestones.title: Automate and observe
milestones.objective: Add a delivery pipeline and basic health monitoring for a deployed service.
milestones.practical_task: Configure CI checks and expose a health endpoint with basic logs.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Automated workflow plus a concise reliability checklist.

portfolio_project.title: Deployable Student API
portfolio_project.brief: Containerize and deploy a small student-facing API, then add an automated delivery check and practical runbook.

roles.title: Security Analyst
roles.summary: Defend applications and infrastructure by finding weaknesses early, monitoring for threats, and driving practical fixes.

grounding.relationship: Closest O*NET occupation reference for Pathfinder's security path. Pathfinder's role title and five milestones are original student-facing curation, not an O*NET occupation or assessment result.

milestones.title: Linux foundations for security
milestones.objective: Work confidently on the command line and read system logs for signs of trouble.
milestones.practical_task: Audit a Linux environment: inventory running services, review authentication logs, and draft a hardening checklist.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Hardening checklist and log-review notes in a repository.

milestones.title: Security scripting with Python
milestones.objective: Automate defensive checks: parse logs, scan configurations, and summarize findings.
milestones.practical_task: Write a Python script that parses authentication logs and flags suspicious patterns.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Defensive log-analysis script with README and sample output.

resources.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python

milestones.title: Web vulnerability basics
milestones.objective: Recognize and explain the most common web vulnerabilities and their fixes.
milestones.practical_task: Complete introductory web-security labs on XSS, SQL injection, and broken authentication, documenting each fix.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Lab write-ups mapping each vulnerability to its remediation.

milestones.title: Detection and monitoring
milestones.objective: Turn logs and metrics into alerts so incidents surface quickly.
milestones.practical_task: Instrument a containerized demo app with structured logs and a dashboard that alerts on errors.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Monitoring dashboard screenshot and alert-rule definitions.

milestones.title: Security audit capstone
milestones.objective: Assess a small application end to end and communicate risk clearly in writing.
milestones.practical_task: Produce a security audit for a sample web app: threat model, prioritized findings, and remediation steps.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Public audit report with severity ratings and before-and-after fixes.

portfolio_project.title: Defensible Security Audit
portfolio_project.brief: Audit a small web application end to end — threat model, prioritized findings, and verified fixes — and publish the report as portfolio evidence.

roles.title: Data Engineer
roles.summary: Build the pipelines and data platforms that move, model, and trust data at scale — the infrastructure behind every dashboard and model.

grounding.relationship: Closest O*NET occupation reference for Pathfinder's data engineering path. Pathfinder's role title and five milestones are original student-facing curation, not an O*NET occupation or assessment result.

milestones.title: Relational data foundations
milestones.objective: Design normalized schemas and query them confidently with SQL.
milestones.practical_task: Design and query a normalized schema for a campus events tracker.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Schema diagram and query set with explanatory notes in a repository.

milestones.title: Python for data pipelines
milestones.objective: Automate extraction, cleaning, and loading with maintainable Python.
milestones.practical_task: Script a pipeline that pulls a public dataset, cleans it, and loads it into Postgres.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Version-controlled ETL script with logging and a sample run output.

milestones.title: Data modeling and warehousing
milestones.objective: Model data for analysis with dimensional designs that stay honest at scale.
milestones.practical_task: Design a star schema for event analytics and defend your grain and dimension choices.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Dimensional model with a written design-decision log.

milestones.title: Containerized data services
milestones.objective: Run pipelines and databases as reproducible, containerized services.
milestones.practical_task: Containerize your pipeline and database with a compose file and one-command startup.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Compose setup plus a README that reproduces the environment locally.

milestones.title: Pipeline capstone
milestones.objective: Ship an end-to-end pipeline with scheduled runs and data quality checks.
milestones.practical_task: Extend your pipeline with a CI-triggered run and automated data quality assertions.
milestones.portfolio_deliverable: Public pipeline case study: architecture diagram, run evidence, and quality-check report.

portfolio_project.title: End-to-End Data Pipeline
portfolio_project.brief: Build a containerized pipeline that extracts a public dataset, models it in a warehouse schema, loads it on a schedule, and proves data quality with automated checks.
